description: Figure: zinc-anchored superposition RMSDs and the LNPK cysteine census excluding a second zinc site
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
seq=''.join(requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9C0E8.fasta',headers=H,timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(16,4.6), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1,1,1.5]})

# Panel 1: zinc-core RMSD (non-discriminating)
ax=axes[0]
labs=['TFIIS\nZn ribbon','RNF4\nRING site-1','c-CBL\nRING site-1']
ax.bar(labs,[0.23,0.31,0.28],color=['#1f77b4','#d62728','#d62728'])
ax.set_ylabel('RMSD to LNPK (A)'); ax.set_ylim(0,2.6)
ax.set_title('Four thiolates alone do not discriminate\n(any tetrahedral Zn-Cys4 core superposes)',fontsize=10,loc='left')

# Panel 2: flanking backbone RMSD (discriminating)
ax=axes[1]
ax.bar(labs,[0.90,2.20,2.27],color=['#1f77b4','#d62728','#d62728'])
ax.set_ylabel('RMSD to LNPK (A)'); ax.set_ylim(0,2.6)
ax.set_title('Backbone path around the metal does:\nCA of each ligand +/- 2 residues (20 atoms)',fontsize=10,loc='left')
for i,v in enumerate([0.90,2.20,2.27]): ax.text(i,v+0.06,f"{v:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=9)

# Panel 3: Cys/His map along LNPK with RING requirement overlay
ax=axes[2]
cys=[i+1 for i,a in enumerate(seq) if a=='C']; his=[i+1 for i,a in enumerate(seq) if a=='H']
ax.hlines(1,1,len(seq),color='0.8',lw=4)
ax.scatter(cys,[1]*len(cys),marker='|',s=400,color='#d62728',lw=2.2,label=f'Cys (n={len(cys)})')
ax.scatter(his,[1]*len(his),marker='|',s=400,color='#ff7f0e',lw=2.2,label=f'His (n={len(his)})')
for p in cys: ax.annotate(f'C{p}',(p,1.06),ha='center',fontsize=8,rotation=90,va='bottom')
ax.axvspan(46,66,color='0.85'); ax.axvspan(78,98,color='0.85')
ax.text(72,0.80,'TM1/TM2',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='0.3')
ax.axvspan(2,45,color='#9467bd',alpha=0.25)
ax.text(23,0.80,'1-45: claimed\nligase region\n0 Cys, 0 His',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#5b2d8e')
ax.axvspan(276,301,color='#1f77b4',alpha=0.25)
ax.text(288,0.80,'276-301\nzinc ribbon',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#14507f')
ax.annotate('RING needs 4 further ligands here\n(spacer + C-terminal): LNPK has none',
            xy=(340,1.0), xytext=(330,1.22), fontsize=8.5, ha='center', color='#d62728',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='#d62728'))
ax.set_xlim(0,len(seq)+5); ax.set_ylim(0.7,1.35); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel('LNPK Q9C0E8 residue'); ax.legend(loc='upper left',fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('Only 6 cysteines in 428 residues; none available\nfor a second zinc site',fontsize=10,loc='left')
plt.suptitle('Zinc-anchored superposition and cysteine census exclude a RING cross-brace in LNPK',fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

pd.DataFrame([
 dict(comparison='LNPK vs TFIIS zinc ribbon (1TFI)', ligand_sep='[3,19,3] vs [3,25,3]', rmsd_4_thiolates=0.23, rmsd_flank_CA=0.90),
 dict(comparison='LNPK vs RNF4 RING site-1 (4AP4)', ligand_sep='[3,19,3] vs [3,24,3]', rmsd_4_thiolates=0.31, rmsd_flank_CA=2.20),
 dict(comparison='LNPK vs c-CBL RING site-1 (1FBV)',ligand_sep='[3,19,3] vs [3,17,3]', rmsd_4_thiolates=0.28, rmsd_flank_CA=2.27),
]).to_csv(os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'lnpk_zinc_anchored_superposition.csv'),index=False)
print("saved lnpk_zinc_anchored_superposition.csv")
